title: Djalma Ganier's Camellia band and its lineup
summary: Glass says Ganier led the Camellia band and lists its players: Bucko Grammar, George Foyer, Bob Anthony, Archie Robinson, Joe Petit, Eddie Summon, Albert Francis and Boybanks, with Glass on bass.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
